name: std::operator<<(std::stacktrace_entry)
intro: Inserts the description of f into the output stream os. Equivalent to return os << std::to_string(f);.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
os

 -

 an output stream


 f

 -

 a stacktrace_entry whose description is to be inserted
